variants.name: inline
findings: Fixed: demo is required Outcome (Kept / Sold) plus Sex in an optional row; one focus ring; disabled text is ink
Open optional Sex row prints "Sex" twice: labelHidden adds class visually-hidden, which bundle.css does not define (it defines st-visually-hidden)
Pressed state presses both options at once

findings.text: labelHidden does not hide: choiceRadios writes class="visually-hidden" (bundle.js:674) but the bundle only defines .st-visually-hidden, so the open optional row reads "Sex Optional" then "Sex  Female  Male".
findings.fix: In choiceRadios use class="st-visually-hidden" for labelHidden.

findings.text: Inline Pressed state shades both options, so it shows two pressed targets at once.
findings.fix: Apply pressed to the first option only (as Focus now does).

findings.text: Atlas Overview shows "No options match your search." under two rows with no search field.
findings.fix: Drop choiceEmpty from the overview, or show it under a search field with a query that matches nothing.
